core: Sodium, potassium and magnesium ion homeostasis
name: Cation homeostasis with paracellular tight-junction magnesium transport
rationale: All members concern renal/epithelial Na+, K+ and Mg2+ handling; unlike the Na/K-ATPase and SLC12 chloride-cotransporter confusables, this theme has tight-junction paracellular transport and magnesium homeostasis.

name: Lymphocyte homing chemotaxis with Cdc42 and PLC-PKC signalling
rationale: Members cover B, T and dendritic cell chemotaxis and migration into lymphoid organs; unlike the dendritic-cell chemokine confusables it centres on lymphocytes, and unlike the lymphoid-tissue development confusable it carries Cdc42 and PLC/PKC signal transduction.

name: G0 quiescence transitions in retinoic acid-induced differentiation
rationale: Members regulate G1-to-G0 and G0-to-G1 transitions coupled to differentiation, with retinoic acid receptor signalling and TFAP2A; confusables instead hold nuclear-receptor transcription, p53/p21 arrest, or TGF-beta/PAX3 programs.

qualifier: PINK1-Parkin and receptor-mediated, with autophagosome assembly control
name: PINK1-Parkin and receptor-mediated mitophagy with autophagosome biogenesis
rationale: Members concern selective mitochondrial autophagy and regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation; confusables lack either the autophagosome assembly regulators or the PINK1-PRKN arm, or add mitochondrial fission/fusion control.

name: Antibacterial and antifungal humoral killing with peptidoglycan hydrolysis
rationale: Members are antimicrobial effector responses (cytolysis, metal sequestration, Gram-positive and fungal defence); what separates it from all four confusables is peptidoglycan metabolism and peptide modification (lysozyme/PGLYRP-type activity).

name: Plasma lipoprotein remodeling and clearance with lipase inhibition
rationale: Members cover remodeling, clearance and assembly of chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL particles with LPL/LIPC; unlike confusables (HDL assembly/efflux, intestinal absorption, triglyceride catabolism) it carries negative regulation of triglyceride catabolism and VLDL remodeling.

name: M-CSF signalling in macrophage proliferation and osteoclast formation
rationale: Members centre on CSF1/M-CSF receptor signalling driving macrophage proliferation and fusion and osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption; confusables lack the osteoclast/bone arm (monocyte/DC differentiation) or the CSF1 and interleukin signalling arm (DAP12, fusion).

name: Nucleotide phosphotransfer, phosphocreatine and NAD(P) salvage metabolism
rationale: Members interconvert and transport high-energy nucleotides (NMP/NDP/NTP, mitochondrial ADP/ATP) and pyridine nucleotide cofactors; it is distinguished by NAD/nicotinate salvage from C1/C4, by nucleotide phosphotransfer from C2 and by creatine/ADP-ATP carrier from C3.

name: Proline and glutamine-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are proline biosynthesis and catabolism plus the general and glutamine-family amino acid terms that contain them; confusables centre on glycine, glyoxylate, serine or generic organic acids instead.

name: ABCA1-dependent HDL biogenesis and lipoprotein remodeling
rationale: Members cover ABCA1-mediated phospholipid efflux, apoA-I signalling and HDL assembly, together with HDL and LDL remodeling; confusables lack the remodeling terms and instead hold LXR-driven efflux, ABCG5/ABCB biliary transport or sphingolipid translocation.

name: Motor behavior and cerebellar-striatal circuit development
rationale: Members are locomotor, postural and motor-learning behaviours together with cerebellar layer and striatum formation (plus a neuronal RNA-regulation module); confusables are sensory/vocal behaviour sets or cerebellar development without motor behaviour.

name: Intracellular glycerolipid storage and lipid droplet turnover
rationale: Members cover triglyceride/DAG/PA synthesis, lipolysis, lipid droplet formation and fusion, lipophagy and fatty-acid oxidation control in adipocytes and other cells; unlike the adipocyte-differentiation confusables it centres on lipid droplet metabolism, and unlike the lipoprotein confusables it is intracellular.

core: Endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane
name: Endocytic recycling and vesicular cholesterol transport to plasma membrane
rationale: Members are plasma membrane-endosome traffic, receptor and endocytic recycling and Golgi-to-surface transport; versus secretory and retrograde Golgi confusables it is plasma-membrane-directed recycling and adds vesicle-mediated cholesterol transport.

qualifier: oncogenic mutants and ERK negative feedback
name: Oncogenic RAF-MEK-ERK activation and ERK negative feedback
rationale: Members are RAF/MAP2K/MAPK activation, BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K/RAS-mutant signalling and ERK inactivation by dephosphorylation and feedback; confusables lack either the oncogenic RAF mutants or the ERK feedback arm and instead carry SOS or RAS-GAP regulation.

name: Mucosal antibacterial and antifungal defence with bacterial agglutination
rationale: Members are antimicrobial effector responses (cytolysis, metal sequestration, neutrophil cytotoxicity, Gram-positive and yeast defence); against confusables it adds mucosal innate immunity and bacterial agglutination and lacks peptidoglycan metabolism, defensins and respiratory burst.

core: Vitamin K and vitamin C metabolism
name: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and ascorbate metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and protein gamma-carboxylation together with ascorbate metabolism and transport and vitamin E response; confusables hold vitamin E/ubiquinol, vitamin D or oxygen transport instead.

name: Canonical Wnt signalling via AXIN-controlled destruction complex stability
rationale: Members concern beta-catenin/TCF signalling and the destruction complex (AXIN1 deletions, APC mutants, AXIN degradation and XAV939 stabilization); confusables lack the AXIN-stability members and carry Wnt target repression or receptor-level DVL/FZD/LRP5 regulation.

core: Canonical NF-kappaB activation via IKK recruitment
name: TNFR1- and TLR-triggered IKK recruitment and NF-kappaB activation
rationale: Members are IKK recruitment and NF-kappaB activation downstream of TNFR1, TLRs (IRAK1/TRAF6/RIP1) with linear ubiquitination; confusables are non-canonical NIK signalling, TAK1-JNK/p38 branches or negative NF-kappaB regulation.

core: Pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion and processing
name: Pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion with KATP channel coupling
rationale: Members are glucose-, incretin-, fatty acid- and neurotransmitter-regulated insulin secretion and insulin processing in beta cells; unlike the insulin-action/GLUT4 confusables it centres on secretion, and unlike C2 it carries KATP channels and beta-cell apoptosis.

name: Skeletal muscle atrophy and restraint of myoblast differentiation
rationale: Members are negative regulation of myoblast/myotube differentiation, satellite-cell maintenance, myoblast proliferation and inactivity-induced atrophy; confusables are positive myogenesis/regeneration, contraction, or hypertrophy sets.

name: Replication-coupled cohesin loading and sister chromatid cohesion establishment
rationale: Members combine cohesin loading, chromatin looping and cohesion establishment with DNA unwinding, polymerase activity and break-induced replication; confusables lack cohesin loading (replication initiation, DNA repair) or concern cohesion resolution and centromeric cohesion.

name: Cranial and peripheral nerve development with hindbrain maturation
rationale: Members are axon guidance and development of cranial nerves, sensory and sympathetic ganglia plus pons/hindbrain maturation; confusables lack the hindbrain maturation terms or the peripheral ganglia and axon guidance arm.

name: Centrosome, mitotic spindle and cytokinesis with centriole-cilium cycling
rationale: Members cover centrosome/centriole duplication, spindle assembly and orientation, AURKA/PLK1 regulation, cytokinesis and cilium disassembly/basal body anchoring; confusables are motile-cilium/IFT, tubulin glutamylation or chromosome condensation/cohesion sets.

name: Germinal-centre class switching and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members are germinal-centre B and Tfh differentiation, plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulin signatures; every confusable lacks the IgG and IgA isotype-switching terms.

name: T cell activation and differentiation from thymocyte stage
rationale: Members are T cell activation/differentiation signatures including double-positive thymocytes, gamma-delta and CD8 differentiation, with generic lymphocyte modules; unlike the TCR-proximal/CD28 confusables it emphasizes differentiation including thymocytes rather than proximal TCR signalling.
